modern: Am I doing anything? I do it with reference to the good of mankind. Does anything happen to me? I accept it and refer it to the gods, and to the source of all things, from which all that happens is derived.

explained.summary: A simple rule for everything. When you act, act for the good of other people. When something happens to you, accept it as coming from the gods, the source from which everything that happens flows.
